items.source:
.hero-blob-anchor { /* backwards per the one-shot release law above (`to` ≡ natural). */
        animation: blob-emerge 500ms var(--ease-decelerate) backwards; }

.overture-appear-active { transition: transform var(--overture-plate-land) var(--spring-snappy);
    transition-delay: var(--overture-appear-delay, 0ms); }

.pane-container--dual { /* Equal columns always (the kept 1fr↔1fr invariant), with the floor
         * explicit: no card ever renders below `--pane-min` on the dual
         * grid. */
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(var(--pane-min), 1fr)); }

.pane-shell > :first-child { /* backwards per the one-shot release law above: the card's natural
         * box-shadow IS var(--shadow-cartoon) (probed computed-equal), so the
         * release at animationend is seamless. */
        animation: plate-land var(--overture-plate-land, 440ms)
            var(--spring-snappy) var(--overture-appear-delay, 0ms) backwards; }

.pane-wrapper--left > .vj-enter-leave-active,
.pane-wrapper--right > .vj-enter-leave-active { transition:
        opacity var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out),
        transform var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out); }

/* thicker operable-chrome borders (one weight bump, not per-component).
     * The `.app-layout` prefix lifts specificity to 0,2,0 so the bump beats the
     * producer SFC-scoped hairline on the in-shell glass surfaces. */
    .console-well,
    .app-layout .glass-resting,
    .app-layout .console-well,
    .slug-pill,
    [role="tab"] { border-width: 2px; }

::-moz-selection { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-live) 32%, transparent);
    color: var(--foreground); }
@property tone { syntax: "<color>"; inherits: false; initial-value: red; }
